meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把 GitHub 代码改动变成讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你常需要向团队或社区清晰展示代码改动
copy.tagline_en: Turn any GitHub pull request into a code-change explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain code changes to teammates or the community

howto.what: 你给 Claude 一个 GitHub 拉取请求（链接或 #号），它会自动读取这次代码改动，做出附旁白和画面的解说视频，最后渲染成 MP4 文件。
howto.when: 当用户提到 GitHub 上的某个 PR（可给链接、owner/repo#号，或在已检出仓库里说“这个 PR”），并要求为这次代码变更做视频时触发；产品推广或无 PR 的主题讲解不会触发，意图不明确会被转去 /hyperframes。

say.text: 把我给的这个 PR 做成代码改动讲解视频
say.note: Claude 会读取该 PR 并开始制作视频。

say.text: 把 owner/repo#123 的修复做成一段解说视频
say.note: 它会拉取这个 PR 的改动来制作。

say.text: 把当前仓库里的“这个 PR”生成变更回顾视频
say.note: 它会把它当作代码变更来处理。

howto.what_en: Once installed, given a GitHub pull request (URL, owner/repo#N, or “this PR”), Claude fetches the code change and creates an explainer video with narration and frames, then renders an MP4 file.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you reference a GitHub pull request (URL, owner/repo#N, or “this PR”) and ask for an explainer video. Not for product promos or non-PR topic videos; unclear intent goes to /hyperframes.

say_en.text: Turn the PR I gave you into a code-change explainer video
say_en.note: Claude reads the PR and starts building the video.

say_en.text: Make a fix-explain video from PR owner/repo#123
say_en.note: It fetches that PR and produces the explainer.

say_en.text: Create a changelog video for “this PR” in the current repo
say_en.note: It treats it as a code change and proceeds.
